metadata.cpu: model name	: 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13500H
metadata.h264: production ScreenContentRealTime/Baseline/Low/Bitrate, skip=true, scene_change=true, AQ=false, background=false, GOP120, 2 threads; deterministic index*1000/30 ms timestamps
metadata.msrv_limit: The current compiler is recorded above. Repository-pinned OpenH264 transitive wide/safe_arch require 1.89; declared Rust 1.88 is not validated by this experiment.
metadata.static_limit: Repeated static input for CPU comparison; production suppresses unchanged capture frames, so this is not idle-desktop bandwidth.
metadata.timing: Synchronous scale + RGBA/I420 conversion + encode, including compressed output copy. FIR retains destination/workspace, image allocates. Frame generation, encoder creation, output decode, async ownership transfer/worker scheduling, capture, network and browser are excluded.

quality_method: FFmpeg format=yuv444p -> PSNR / SSIM, on 640x220 native text ROI; compression-only ROI at encoder resolution; first measured repeat only. Display reconstruction uses image Triangle, not actual GPU/browser rendering.
